Although the properties listed above are considered vacant by the municipality, vacancy does not necessarily mean
that these lots are available for purchase. Parties interested in any of these properties should check property
signage, consult their local MLS listings, or visit a registry office with the legal description to attain the necessary
owner contact information.

Note: The City uses development permit issuance
to determine when lots have become unavailable.
Please note that some lots depicted as available
on this map may be sold but have not yet received
development permit approval.
